foods_to_include: Whole Grains: Oats, quinoa, brown rice, whole-wheat bread/pasta (prioritize complex carbohydrates)
Legumes: Lentils, chickpeas, black beans, kidney beans (excellent source of fiber and plant protein)
Fruits: Berries, apples, pears, oranges (focus on whole fruits with skin for fiber)
Vegetables: A wide variety of colorful vegetables including leafy greens (spinach, kale), broccoli, bell peppers, carrots, sweet potatoes
Lean Proteins: Chicken breast (skinless), turkey, fish (salmon, mackerel, sardines - especially for omega-3s), tofu, tempeh, eggs
Healthy Fats: Avocado, olive oil, nuts (almonds, walnuts), seeds (chia seeds, flaxseeds, pumpkin seeds)
Dairy/Alternatives: Low-fat Greek yogurt, fortified plant-based milk (almond, soy, oat - unsweetened)
Herbs and Spices: To enhance flavor without added sodium or unhealthy fats
Foods fortified with Vitamin D: Some milks, cereals, and orange juice (check labels)
foods_to_avoid: Sugary Drinks: Sodas, fruit juices (even 100% juice, due to high sugar content), sweetened teas/coffees
Refined Grains: White bread, white pasta, white rice, sugary cereals (these can rapidly increase blood glucose)
Processed Snacks: Chips, cookies, pastries, candy bars
Deep-fried Foods: French fries, fried chicken, donuts
High Saturated and Trans Fats: Red and processed meats (bacon, sausage, hot dogs), full-fat dairy products, butter, tropical oils (palm oil, coconut oil in excess), commercially baked goods
Added Sugars: Foods with high fructose corn syrup, sucrose, dextrose, etc.
Excessive Sodium: Processed foods, canned soups, frozen dinners (check labels)
